name: workos
description: Build enterprise-ready auth with WorkOS: AuthKit, SSO, Directory Sync, RBAC, and Audit Logs.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate AuthKit, SSO, Directory Sync, RBAC, and Audit Logs with WorkOS.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to the official WorkOS MCP documentation server for current SDK docs, examples, and changelogs, and ships dense skills for the build: AuthKit sessions with authkit-nextjs (withAuth, middleware, callback routes), enterprise SSO and Directory Sync with the Admin Portal, role-based access control with session claims, Audit Logs event streams, Vault for per-tenant secrets, plus API key management, environments, and signed webhooks.
defaultPrompt: Add AuthKit authentication to my Next.js app with protected routes
Wire up enterprise SSO and Directory Sync for a new customer org
Emit audit log events for the sensitive actions in my API
